LightningComponentBundle.description: Salesforce list views for LWR sites — switch views, browse records, create new list views

property.name: tableId
property.label: Table ID
property.description: Required unique id for this list table (e.g. work-cases, work-tasks). Used to store and restore pinned list views.

property.name: defaultListViewApiName
property.label: Default List View API Name
property.description: Usually All or All_Envelope__c depending on the object

property.name: pageSize
property.label: Page Size
property.description: Number of rows shown per page in the table.
